news.title: NextVoiceCord Help Menu
news.information: NextVoiceCord is a self-hosted Discord music bot. It plays from YouTube and SoundCloud, keeps a queue and history, and remembers per-server settings.
news.getStarted:
```
Join a voice channel, then run /play <song or URL>.
Names, links, and playlist links all work.
```

tutorial.steps:
```
1. Join a voice channel.
2. Run /play <song or URL> (or !play with the text prefix).
3. Use /queue to see what's up next, /skip to vote-skip, /volume to adjust volume.
4. DJs and admins get extra controls — check the DJ and Admin tabs.
```

config.aliasesReadOnlyNote: Command aliases are a nested structure and cannot be safely edited from a single field. Edit commands.aliases in config.txt directly, then restart.
config.clearChannelAgeDays: Clear channel max age in days (0 = unlimited)
config.discordTokenWarning: Editing this incorrectly will stop the bot from starting. Only paste a token copied directly from the Discord Developer Portal.
config.evalWarning: DANGEROUS: lets the bot owner run arbitrary code in the bot's own process. Anyone with owner access could then do anything the machine running the bot can do. Only enable this if you fully understand and accept that risk.
config.lavalinkEngineFallbackNote: "fallback" is not implemented yet (planned for a later stage: both engines live, with a handover on node failure). Choosing it now logs a warning at startup and the bot plays through lavaplayer until it is implemented.
config.lavalinkNodesNote: Stage 1 only ever uses the first node in this list. Adding more builds toward routing across multiple nodes, planned for a later stage — until then, only the first one is live.
